blocks.notes: the near slice: Atlanta Center on the Montgomery RCAG, both ATIS broadcasts, Cairns Approach, guard, and the Montgomery and Troy ground stations
the field slice: the shared CTAF, Andalusia, Montgomery Approach and Troy Tower
the high slice: Atlanta Center south, the Cairns sector over Goshen, and Jacksonville Center on the Dothan RCAG

description: A listening day on the airband: three slices of the sky in rotation. Each block is the center of a slice - every channel inside it is heard at once, and each transmission is kept as a clip and logged as a voice event. While a slice listens, ADS-B and the sensors go dark; the weekday plan is the other way to spend the tuner, and choosing between the plans is the owner's call, made whenever they like.
name: airband
